protocol_note: Windows are Protocol 1's exact chunk set: 602 x 512-token windows over the full WikiText-2 test set (corpus: /srv/bench/corpus/wikitext2-test.txt -- Protocol 1's ACTUAL file per run-perplexity.sh; NOTE it differs from the legacy NVFP4 run's corpus /srv/bench/perplexity/wikitext-2-test.txt: 308,707 vs 297,053 tokens -- a 4th difference axis: different corpus conversions), derived with the GGUF tokenizer (llama-server /tokenize, add_special=true) to match llama.cpp's 602-chunk split. vLLM retokenizes each window's text with its own HF tokenizer; per-window retokenization drift is recorded in vllm_n_tokens. Scoring: token_logprobs at positions >= 256 (second half of each window; first 256 tokens are context only), per the audited Protocol 1 description in CLAUDE.md. Full per-token logprobs (all positions) are in nvfp4-p1-token-logprobs.json for post-hoc re-scoring. This run is NOT comparable to Protocol 2 or to the legacy nvfp4-vllm-ppl.json (160 chunks, no context).

alt_score_positions_1plus.note: mean NLL over positions 1..end of every window; kept for scoring-rule cross-check
